errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the black diagonal line as representing Croatia. The grey line represents Croatia, while the black line is a reference line (y=x).
The description provides completely fabricated start and end coordinates for the black line. The black line actually runs from approximately (20, 20) to (80, 80).
The starting point for the orange line (Romania) is approximately (28, 35), not (20, 38).

The description incorrectly reports the end point for the blue line (Bulgaria). The labeled end point for Bulgaria is (52.4; 51.8). The description uses the x-coordinate from Romania's end point (68.9).
The description completely omits the grey line, which represents Croatia's data.
